Strategy: Send small items to the loosest bin to save tight bins for future large items, and use Best Fit for larger items. Small items fit almost anywhere, so wasting loose capacity on them costs little. It may help by reserving tight fits, but may fail if small items arrive in long runs and loose bins fill unevenly.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if item <= 25 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
